title: 帧调度用定时器时写一次性的 setTimeout；用 setInterval 就由同一句柄 clearInterval

triggers.read: 源端 onDraw 尾部的 invalidate() 每次只请求下一帧一次 onDraw
triggers.wrong: 帧调度写成 setInterval(…, 16)，回调里只把句柄变量复位（如置 -1）、不调 clearInterval，随后绘制尾部又开新的 setInterval

scope: ArkUI 自绘视图的帧调度没有用 UIContext.postFrameCallback、改用定时器时

how.text: 首选 uiContext.postFrameCallback 对齐 vsync；只能用定时器时写 setTimeout(cb, 16) 做一次性调度
若用 setInterval，回调完成或停止时调 clearInterval(同一个返回值) 再复位句柄；不在回调里只复位 id 后再开新定时器

values.value: setInterval(handler: Function | string, delay: number, ...arguments: any[]): number；只能调 clearInterval 手动删除
values.meaning: 重复定时器，不清就一直触发

values.value: setTimeout(handler: Function | string, delay?: number, ...arguments: any[]): number；回调执行后自动删除
clearInterval(intervalID?: number): void；不传 ID 时不取消任何定时器
values.meaning: 取消 setInterval 返回的那个定时器，要在创建它的线程里删

why: 旧 interval 不停，动画期间每次触发再开一个，数量约每帧翻倍，动画结束后仍持续全量重绘、占满 UI 线程

probe.note: 用了重复定时器；看同一个返回值有没有 clearInterval，是不是被当成一次性帧调度

siblings_checked: 无：setTimeout/setInterval/clearInterval 是全局函数，没有专门的参数类型可搜

refs.what: setInterval 只能用 clearInterval 删除
refs.quote:
Sets a repeating timer for the system to repeatedly call a function at a fixed interval.
 * The timer can only be manually deleted by calling the clearInterval API.
export declare function setInterval(handler: Function | string, delay: number, ...arguments: any[]): number;
The timer is automatically deleted after the callback is executed, and can be manually deleted by calling the clearTimeout API.
export declare function setTimeout(handler: Function | string, delay?: number, ...arguments: any[]): number;
* @param { number } [intervalID] - ID of the repeating timer to cancel, which is returned by setInterval(). If this parameter is omitted, no timer is canceled.
export declare function clearInterval(intervalID?: number): void;
